name: refracting-missile-fractal-damage
notes: Refracting Missile (6ffqsuo6gb, WATER ACTION, MAGE) deals damage to target unit equal to the amount of Fractal objects controlled plus 1 (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php, cardActivatedAbilities["6ffqsuo6gb:0"]:15988 queues the MZCHOOSE target; customDQHandlers["6ffqsuo6gb:0:CardActivated-1"]:32963 computes damage = count(ZoneSearch("myField", cardSubtypes: ["FRACTAL"])) + 1). Hydrating Fractal (LAfJuHgUbm, WATER PHANTASIA, CLERIC/FRACTAL subtypes, no On Enter or passive text) is seeded directly onto the field as the single controlled Fractal object (N=1), so expected damage = 2 -- non-trivial and distinguishable from a hypothetical always-1 stub. WATER element access for playing Refracting Missile itself comes for free from the Spirit of Water (tafqldAGRF) starting champion; this card has no Class Bonus/Diao Chan Bonus gating so no additional champion patch is needed. Reserve cost 3 is paid via 3 myHand-0 picks, then the MZCHOOSE target picks the opponent's champion (theirField-0, a legal CHAMPION target).

rulesClauses: Deal damage to target unit equal to the amount of Fractal objects you control plus 1.
